Upload requirements

Files must be clear, colour scans or photos — no screenshots.

Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, PDF · max 5 MB per file.

All four corners of the document must be visible.

Name on documents must match your bank account name.

Expired documents are auto-flagged 30 days before expiry.

Review usually completes within 24–48 working hours.

Never share your KYC documents with anyone claiming to be HaatBazar staff over phone or WhatsApp.
